requests.purpose: confirm exact league id / shortcut / season for the Bundesliga 2026-27
confirm result-type kinds (After90Minutes etc.) used for explicit regulation scores
whole Bundesliga season (306 matches): results, fixtures, kickoff UTC, ids, result types
current matchday for the change-date polling probe

limits.expected_rate: at most ~25 requests/minute vs documented limit 60/minute/IP; whole pilot = 6 requests
limits.retry_policy: 429/5xx/network error: exponential back-off (Retry-After honoured), at most 2 retries per request, then abort

preconditions: contact configured via env FOOTIQ_CONTACT or untracked config/contact.local (checked before any request; value never shown)
no Bundesliga match scheduled between 1 h before kickoff and 3 h after kickoff (checked against the stored schedule)
plan sha256 supplied by the owner equals the sha256 of this plan
abort_if: R1 does not list leagueId 4937 / bl1 / 2026
user_agent: FootIQ-ResultsAdapters-OpenLigaDBBot/1.0.0 (+local research project; <contact from env/untracked file - not shown>)
attribution: Daten von OpenLigaDB (www.openligadb.de), lizenziert unter ODbL 1.0 (stored on every record and snapshot)
outputs: pilot/<run_id>/ staging records, reconciliation tables, validation report, isolated refreshed universe (NOT the feature store)
not_done: no change to the official feature store, frozen datasets, models, protocol or logger
no official logging, no approval JSON
